title: Nutritious Post-Workout Kenyan Cornmeal Stew
description: A hearty, mustardy stew featuring cornmeal as the main ingredient, perfect for post-workout nutrition and a paleo-friendly diet.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the mustard seeds, tomato paste, chicken broth, and water to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the cornmeal has absorbed most of the liquid.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
